messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for region ap-south (az5) - capacity_saturated on inference-pool-az5. PD incident: INC24198765. Auto-page: oncall-primary.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty triggered INC24198765 -> paging kate (oncall) :pager:
kate: Acked. I’m jumping in — looking at autoscaler and GPU pool.
kate: Seeing a lot of KV cache evictions and queued requests on az5. Latency > 800ms for 99th pct. Customers getting rate-limited errors.
mike: @kate do we have any hot spares in az5 or can we trigger cross-az fallback to az4/az6?
kate: No hot spares left in az5. I’m going to enable routing fallback policy to prefer az4 for new requests and start an emergency scale on az4.
sanjay: Quick check — autoscaler logs show repeated OOMs in the allocator: `gpu_mem_alloc_fail` across many pods. Suspect model shard rebalancer not keeping up.
emily: Pasting relevant logs:
```
2026-03-14T18:07:12Z inference-runtime[shard-12]: ERR gpu_mem_alloc_fail size=23GB avail=21GB
2026-03-14T18:07:13Z batching-svc: WARN prefix_cache_eviction key=usr:abc shard=12
```
jordan: I’ll open a fastfail route to reduce seq_len on high-cost models for latency-sensitive endpoints. Patch below:
```
route.modify({
  region: 'ap-south',
  prefer_zones: ['az4','az6'],
  model_fallback: ['gpt-l-quant','gpt-m-quant']
})
```
kate: Executed route change. Confirmed new incoming requests should prefer az4.
kate: Also triggered dedicated-pool scale: `infra scale pool=dedicated-az4 count+6 --priority=urgent` — started provisioning.
oncall-rotation-bot: Note: if on-call >30m, perform handoff to next responder. Next: mike.
mike: I’m taking over from @kate for mitigation steps. Observability — what's customer impact? any enterprise customers showing 5xx spikes?
emily: CS alert: two customers (acme-inc, nova.ai) reported degraded API responses and timeouts starting ~18:06 UTC. Error spike at 18:09 UTC to 5% 5xx for acme-inc.
mike: Ok. Initiating immediate fallback for acme-inc to a reserved dedicated pool in az4: `routing.set(customer=acme-inc, prefer_pool=reserved-acme-az4)`
incident-bot: Action logged: fallback enabled for customer acme-inc by mike.
kate: After route change, global 95th latency dropped from 480ms -> 220ms in about 60s for new sessions. Existing sticky sessions still hitting az5 and queue.
sanjay: I’m going to cordon nodes in az5 showing memory pressure and restart the allocator service to free up KV cache references. Command: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-az5-12 && kubectl rollout restart ds/allocator -n inference`.
jordan: Also temporarily disabling large batch pooling in az5 to lower memory pressure: `config.update batch.max_tokens=2048 for region=ap-south:az5`.
mike: PD: Escalating to tier2 infra (sre-oncall) for capacity provisioning ETA. @sre-oncall please confirm.
PagerDuty: Escalation: routing to sre-oncall -> notified user: sanjay (sre-oncall)
sanjay: I see the infra team is spinning up 6 GPUs in az4 (warm). ETA ~7 minutes. Also kicking off shard rebalancer: `rebalancer.start --region ap-south --exclude az5 --parallel 4`.
kate: Noting customer impact: estimated 12% of traffic from ap-south is impacted, mostly endpoints hitting long-context models. We should alert account teams.
emily: I sent a holding message to ACME support channel: "We are experiencing degraded inference performance in ap-south; we’ve enabled fallback routing and are provisioning capacity. ETA 10-15m. Will update." :email:
mike: Good. Keep CS posted. For mitigation timeline: scale and rebalancer likely fix within 10-12m, after that we can gradually re-enable az5 routing.
oncall-rotation-bot: Reminder: if escalation to PD required, add postmortem owner and severity. Current severity: Sev2 (partial customer impact, mitigation in progress).
kate: Quick test after fallback: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "x-region: ap-south" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 200 OK, latency ~210ms. :white_check_mark:
mike: Rebalancer logs showing progress:
```
[18:16:30] rebalancer: moved shard 34 -> az4
[18:17:02] rebalancer: moved shard 35 -> az4
```
sanjay: After node cordon + restarts, az5 allocator error rate reduced. But we should keep fallback active for 20m to ensure warmup.
emily: Noting PD incident timeline in ticket: ack at 18:08, handoff to mike at 18:11, scale started 18:12.
kate: I’ll keep monitoring and start collecting metrics/trace artifacts for postmortem (KV eviction rates, seq_len distribution, allocation failures).
mike: Looks stable for new traffic. Marking incident as mitigated but not resolved. Will close PD after 45m if no regressions.
incident-bot: Incident INC24198765 status: mitigated -> assigned to mike for postmortem. Postmortem owner: mike.
sanjay: Action items: (1) postmortem with root cause (allocator + rebalancer interaction), (2) add autoscaler guardrail to prevent complete depletion in zone, (3) improve warm spare strategy for AZ failover.
emily: I’ll coordinate customer comms for acme-inc & nova.ai after final resolution.
mike: Thanks all. I’ll update the PD incident and follow up with a detailed timeline. Closing slack thread when resolved. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty: Incident INC24198765 marked mitigated by mike at 18:37 UTC.
incident-bot: Note: follow-up doc required. Tagging for postmortem review in next infra retrospective.
